name: EPIC 210797297
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.6 solar radii and 1.70 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210797297 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.60456 (16th-84th percentiles 10.480841-10.863872), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210797297: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5071.9375 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210797297 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3157.539062 (16th-84th percentiles 3115.976562-3213.4375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,158 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.70 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,072 K at its surface.
